page.layout: One title page: a large title block at the top centre, with a small line above it; a blue paper patch covers the centre of the page; a short block of small lines sits in the lower centre under the patch. No running head, page number or margin notes are legible. Mirrored show-through from the reverse appears at the top centre and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The centre of the page is covered by a blue paper patch, so the main title block is largely hidden. The large title lines at the top are set in a heavy display face, but the scan is too faded and show-through from the reverse is too strong to read any word with confidence, so every line is marked illegible. Lines in the lower centre are very small and under the patch; they cannot be read. The lines marked above are estimates of their position on the page, not of their contents, and the letter counts are rough. No printed words were read with certainty, so no words were transcribed.
